title: Failed backflow inspection: separate the finding from the repair
description: A failed inspection needs classification before repair: visual condition findings, failed test results, and program compliance gaps lead to different next.
prompt: Is this a condition finding, a failed certified test, or both?
answer: A failed inspection needs classification before repair: visual condition findings, failed test results, and program compliance gaps lead to different next steps. Preserve the written finding rather than treating the word failed as a diagnosis.
urgency: Escalate active leakage, damage, compliance deadlines, or unclear assembly identity.
identifiers: The written finding should state the asset and observed issue or test result.
A certified failure can require repair plus retest before filing.
Condition observations do not establish part compatibility by themselves.
